title: kb_monitor_status with a panel returns the panel JSON without redact.redact
goal: kb_monitor_status with panel NAME passes the panel JSON through redact.redact like every other kb tool output, and the tool description no longer says at most 25 lines for it

run:
import sys, json, types
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kb_mcp
secret = "gl" + "pat-" + "A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0"
doc = json.dumps({"panels": {"kb": {"note": secret}}})
kb_mcp.subprocess.run = lambda *a, **k: types.SimpleNamespace(returncode=0, stdout=doc, stderr="")
out = kb_mcp.kb_monitor_status({"panel": "kb"})
print("secret survives:", secret in out)
sys.exit(1 if secret in out else 0)

import sys, json, types
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kb_mcp
needles = [
    "gh" + "p_" + "A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6Q7r8",
    "AK" + "IA" + "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP",
    "gl" + "pat-" + "A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0",
    "xo" + "xb-" + "1234567890-abcdefghij",
    "sk-" + "ant-" + "A1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1",
    "ey" + "J" + "abcdefghij1234" + ".ey" + "J" + "abcdefghij1234" + ".abcdefghij1234",
    "Zq9xW7vT5rE3",
]
text = " ".join(needles[:-1]) + " password = " + chr(34) + needles[-1] + chr(34)
doc = json.dumps({"panels": {"kb": {"note": text}}})
kb_mcp.subprocess.run = lambda *a, **k: types.SimpleNamespace(returncode=0, stdout=doc, stderr="")
out = kb_mcp.kb_monitor_status({"panel": "kb"})
left = [s for s in needles if s in out]
print("secrets surviving:", len(left), "of", len(needles))
sys.exit(1 if left else 0)
